functionality.rationale: Cancellation must reach one deterministic terminal result from every transfer phase.

security.rationale: Cleanup must not leave attacker-controlled partial files or delete committed or unrelated data.

performance.rationale: Cancellation latency and already queued work must remain bounded under load.

compatibility.rationale: Local and remote cancellation must preserve v1 CANCEL and terminal-state semantics.

concurrency.rationale: Cancel, commit, network completion, file writes, and engine stop can race from both peers.

platform.rationale: Socket, descriptor, worker, and temporary-file cleanup differ across desktop platforms.

persistence.rationale: Failure cleanup must remove only the current transfer's temporary and resumable state.

adr.rationale: The task implements protocol v1 cancellation semantics without changing public contracts.

architecture.rationale: Cancellation remains inside existing session, transfer, and storage ownership.

roadmap.rationale: The roadmap item closes only after adapter, UI, and E2E acceptance.

acceptance.note: Accepted by the integration owner after repository verification.
